info.title: osm-route-details
info.description: Elevation and typology (structure, surface) along a route.

get.description: Ready when the configured local data is readable; remote sources are not checked.
Full attributions of the configured data sources, to be relayed to end users.
Input bounds, applied defaults, option bounds, enum values, data capabilities and elevation sources.

post.summary: Compute elevation and typology along a route
post.description: Validates the route and its options before any computation. Unknown keys, out-of-bounds options and coordinates outside the Web Mercator range give a 400 that lists every faulty field by JSON pointer; input bounds give a 413 with `details.limit`. A 200 carries the elevation profile (`points`), the route aggregates (`summary`), the terrain provenance and warnings (`quality`) and the attribution.

422.description: No data from any source on the route

503.description: Data unavailable (`data_unavailable`, `details.source`) or too many requests queued (`overloaded`); always with `Retry-After`

504.description: Request budget exceeded (`timeout`), in queue or during computation; never a truncated response

AdaptedRangeV1.description: A range read on GLO-30 (a surface model), with the threshold applied there.

text.description: Short notice to display, covering every configured source.

AttributionRefV1.description: Mandatory notice of the configured sources and link to the full list.

BreakpointReasonV1.description: Why a point was inserted (open list: clients ignore unknown values).

BreakpointRulesV1.description: Breakpoint selection thresholds; distances in metres.

grade_min_delta_pct.description: Grades around a grade change differ by at least this, in percentage points.

grade_min_run_m.description: Both stretches around a grade change are at least this long.

grade_tolerance_m.description: Vertical tolerance of the grade change search.

max_inserted_per_km.description:
Inserted points over any sliding kilometre, at most; structure, gap, terrain, overpass and
surface breakpoints are never dropped.

max_inserted_total.description: Inserted points over the whole route, at most.

merge_m.description: Candidate breakpoints closer than this are merged into one point.

min_spacing_m.description: A summit, low point or grade change closer than this to a kept point is dropped.

overpass_snap_m.description: The same for a bridge crossing above the route (`overpass_crossing`, api 1.4).

snap_m.description: A breakpoint this close to an input point is carried by it, without a new point.

defaults.description: Values applied when an option is absent.

elevation_rules.description: Elevation rules that shape the output.

elevation_sources.description: Configured elevation sources, in priority order.

typology_rules.description: Typology rules that shape the output.

CorrectionStatusV1.description: Correction status of one kind of structure.

DataFeatures.description: Capabilities of the active data sources.

indicative.description: Source read online: the version is indicative only.

EdgeNodeV1.description: End of an edge: a junction of the bicycle street graph (degree other than 2).

degree.description:
Number of distinct neighbouring nodes among the streets open to bicycles: 1 for a dead end,
3 or more for a junction.

id.description:
`z14:<x>:<y>`: integer position on the global zoom 14, extent 4096 tile grid (about 0.4 to
0.6 m in France). The same junction gives the same id for every route on the same
`data_versions.streets`; it stays stable across data updates while the OSM node does not
move and survives tile simplification. Not an OSM id.

EdgeOnewayV1.description:
One-way restriction of the travelled part of an edge, relative to the travel direction (general
OSM `oneway`; `oneway:bicycle` is not in the tiles).

EdgeV1.description:
A street graph edge travelled by the matched route (api 1.7). Edges are cut at junctions
(degree other than 2, dead ends included), never at tile borders, way ends or attribute
changes. Unmatched stretches give no edge (a gap in `from_m`/`to_m`); a U-turn closes the
edge being travelled, so the same edge may appear twice, once in each direction.

from_gain_cum_m.description:
Cumulative elevation gain and loss at `from_m` and `to_m`, on the profile of
`points[].gain_cum_m`: the gain of the edge is `to_gain_cum_m - from_gain_cum_m`.

from_index.description: Client index of the last input point at or before `from_m`.

from_m.description: Distance along the route, on the same scale as `segments[]`.

oneOf.description:
End of the whole edge on the entry side, in travel direction; `null` when it lies outside
the street graph read around the route (corridor of `typology_rules`, unread tile).

from_offset_m.description: Entry position along the whole edge, from `from_node`; `null` when `from_node` is.

geometry.description:
Travelled geometry snapped on the street, in travel direction: encoded polyline (Google
algorithm), precision 6.

length_m.description: Network length of the whole edge, in metres; `null` when an end is unknown.

partial.description:
The route does not travel the edge from one end to the other (route start or end, U-turn,
unknown end).

oneOf.description: Source structure of the travelled ways, when the same all along (no structure heuristic).
Surface of the travelled ways, when the same all along; otherwise cross with `segments[]`.

to_index.description: Client index of the first input point at or after `to_m`.

oneOf.description: End of the whole edge on the exit side; `null` as `from_node`.

to_offset_m.description: Exit position along the whole edge, from `from_node`; `null` when `from_node` is.

oneOf.description: Way kind of the travelled ways, when the same all along.

EdgesFeatureV1.description: How `edges[]` identifies nodes and encodes geometries (api 1.7).

node_grid_zoom.description: Zoom and extent of the global tile grid of node ids.

node_id_prefix.description: Prefix of `edges[].from_node.id`, followed by `:<x>:<y>` on the grid below.

oneway_bicycle.description: `oneway:bicycle` is read (contraflow cycle lanes); `false`: general `oneway` only.

way_id.description: OSM way ids are given (not with the current street tiles).

EleMethodV1.description: Elevation method of a point or station.

smoothing_m.description: 0 (disabled) or within the published bounds, in metres.

gain_presets.description: Hysteresis threshold and smoothing half-width of each gain preset, in metres.

glo30_min_range_m.description: GLO-30 ranges shorter than this are not adapted, and shorter gaps are closed, in metres.

glo30_threshold_m.description: Threshold applied on GLO-30 ranges (a surface model), in metres.

station_step_m.description: Spacing of the internal stations, in metres.

EnumCatalog.description: Every public value of the contract enums.

FieldError.description: Error on an input field: a JSON pointer, never the value.

pointer.description: JSON pointer (RFC 6901) to the faulty field.

GainParamsV1.description: Effective parameters of the elevation gain.

adapted.description: GLO-30 ranges where the threshold was adapted.

partial.description: Some elevation ranges are missing: the gain sums the ranges that were read.

GainPreset.description: Elevation gain preset: threshold and smoothing scale of the gain computation.

LatencyTargetV1.description:
Order of magnitude aimed at for one route, measured on the deployment of reference; not a
guarantee (the request budget still applies).

route_km.description: Length of the reference route, in kilometres.

Limits.description: Input bounds; beyond them, the request gets a 413.

densified_max.description: Maximum number of internal stations implied by the bounds; not a bound itself.

MetaV1.description:
Versions and request identity: equal requests with equal versions give equal responses, apart
from `request_id` and `duration_ms`.

data_versions.description: Version of each data source used by this request.

profile.description:
Effective processing profile (api 1.5): part of the request identity, like the versions.
A `fast` response is meant to be refined later by a `full` request.

debug.description: Internal use only; refused unless the deployment allows it.

edges.description:
Return `edges[]`, the street graph edges travelled by the matched route (api 1.7).
Default: `false`. Independent of `sections`.

sections.description: Response sections to return; default: all.

OutputPointV1.description: A point of the elevation profile.

d_m.description: Cumulative distance from the start, in metres.

ele.description: Elevation after structure correction, not smoothed; `null` when missing.

gain_cum_m.description:
Cumulative elevation gain from the start, in metres (api 1.5), on the same internal
profile as `summary.gain_m`: non-decreasing, the last point carries `summary.gain_m`. The
gain of a sub-range is the difference of its two ends (never recomputed from `ele`).

index.description: Client index of the input point, or of the last input point before it.

lat.description: Only on inserted points and in `distance` mode.

lon.description: Only on inserted points and in `distance` mode.

loss_cum_m.description:
Cumulative elevation loss from the start, positive, in metres (api 1.5); the last point
carries `summary.loss_m`.

reasons.description:
Insertion reasons (`input_with_breakpoints` mode): always on an inserted point, on an input
point only when a breakpoint falls on it.

PointOriginV1.description: `input` for a client point, `inserted` for a point added by the service.

PointV1.description: Input point; an optional altitude (`ele` or `alt`) is accepted and ignored.

unknown_keys.description: JSON pointers of every unknown key.

Profile.description:
Processing profile. `full` (default): IGN LiDAR HD in France with its surface model, all
structure corrections and heuristics. `fast`: low latency for interactive use, Mapterhorn
only (no IGN read, own queue, never waits behind `full` requests), OSM bridges and tunnels
interpolated between their ends, no heuristic detection. Same response shape; the effective
profile is in `meta.profile`.

ProfileV1.description: What a processing profile reads and corrects, and its latency target.

bridge_dsm.description:
Bridge decks read in the IGN surface model; otherwise bridges are interpolated between
their abutments.

elevation_sources.description: Elevation sources this profile may read, in priority order (`elevation_sources[].source`).

heuristics.description: Detection of structures missing from OSM, galleries and covers.

own_queue.description: Requests of this profile have their own queue: they never wait behind the other profile.

elevation_coverage.description: Share of the length with an elevation, in [0, 1].

inferred_surface_ratio.description: Share of the length whose surface is inferred (tracktype or way kind), in [0, 1].

matched_ratio.description: Share of the length matched on the street network, in [0, 1].

Readiness.description: Observed state of the configured local data.

RouteDetailsRequestV1.description: Body of `POST /v1/route-details`: exactly one of `points` or `polyline`.

polyline_precision.description: Precision of `polyline` (5 or 6); required with `polyline`, refused with `points`.

RouteDetailsResponseV1.description:
Response of `POST /v1/route-details`. `meta`, `status`, `quality` and `attribution` are always
present; `points` and `summary` follow the requested `sections`.

edges.description:
Street graph edges travelled by the matched route, in travel order (api 1.7); only with
`options.edges`.

segments.description: Contiguous homogeneous stretches covering the whole route (section `typology`).

step_m.description: Profile step in `distance` mode, in metres (bounds: `/v1/capabilities`).

SegmentV1.description: A contiguous homogeneous stretch of the route.

ele_method.description: Dominant elevation method on the stretch.

from_index.description: Client index of the last input point at or before `from_m`.

grade_pct.description: Mean grade, in percent; `null` when an end has no elevation.

matched.description:
`false` on a stretch not matched on the bicycle street network. Since api 1.1, a stretch
that follows a way closed to bicycles (motorway, trunk, `bicycle=no` road...) stays
`false` but carries the `structure`, `surface` and `way_kind` of that way, with the
warnings `unmatched_range` and `bicycle_forbidden`; its structures are not corrected.

oneOf.description: Only on a bridge or a tunnel.

to_index.description: Client index of the first input point at or after `to_m`.

oneOf.description:
Only when `matched` is `false` (api 1.7): `closed_to_bicycles` (a way closed to bicycles is
followed, warning `bicycle_forbidden`), `off_network` (no street of the bicycle network
within reach: way missing from the tiles, stray GPS points), `no_data` (street tiles
missing or failed). Segments also split on a change of reason.

StatusV1.description: `partial` when a source gave no data on part of the route.

StructureCorrectionV1.description: Structure correction: a status per kind, and counters of `summary.structures[]` entries.

counts.description:
Entries per method (`dsm_deck`, `interpolated_structure`, `kept_ground`, `uncorrected`);
zero counters are omitted.

counts_by_source.description: Entries per `structure_source`; zero counters are omitted.

StructureEntryV1.description: A bridge or tunnel met on the route.

StructureMethodV1.description:
Method applied to a structure: `kept_ground` is a bridge with no deck above the ground (counted
as corrected), `none` an uncorrected structure.

StructureSourceV1.description: Origin of a structure: OSM tags, heuristic detection, or both.

StructureV1.description:
Structure of a segment; `ford` is reserved, `unknown` is an unmatched stretch with no known
way. On a way closed to bicycles (warning `bicycle_forbidden`), the structure of that way.

SummaryV1.description: Route aggregates, computed on the internal 5 m profile.

by_structure_m.description: Length per `structure` value, in metres; zero values are omitted.

by_surface_class_m.description: Length per `surface.class` value, in metres; zero values are omitted.

by_surface_detail_m.description:
Length per `surface.detail` value, in metres (api 1.6); segments without `detail` are not
counted, so the values may sum to less than `length_m`.

by_surface_source_m.description: Length per `surface.source` value, in metres; zero values are omitted.

by_way_kind_m.description: Length per `way_kind` value, in metres; zero values are omitted.

structures.description:
Bridges and tunnels met on the bicycle network, sorted by distance: one entry per run of
elements of the same kind on each passage. Structures of a way closed to bicycles are
not listed (segments only, warning `bicycle_forbidden`).

terrain_m.description: Length per terrain origin, in metres (keys: `terrain_origin` values).

unknown_m.description: Length not matched on the street network, in metres.

SurfaceDetailV1.description:
Fine surface (api 1.6), only from a recognised raw OSM `surface` tag, never inferred. Open
list: a client tolerates an unknown value and falls back on `class`. Each value implies one
`class`: `asphalt`, `concrete`, `paving_stones`, `sett`, `cobblestone` are `paved`; the others
are `unpaved`.

SurfaceSourceV1.description: How the surface class was obtained.

oneOf.description:
Fine surface (api 1.6); absent when the way has no raw `surface` tag the service
recognises, or when the tag names no material (`paved`, `unpaved`). Segments also split on
a change of `detail`.

TerrainRangeV1.description: Terrain read on a range of the route.

fallback_after_error.description: Fallback after a source failure, as opposed to a normal fallback outside coverage.

measured.description: Whether this origin has been measured by a benchmark.

TypologyRulesV1.description: Map matching and segmentation rules of `rules_version`.

beta_m.description: Scale of the transition cost, in metres.

footway_cost.description: Extra emission cost of a footway, steps or pedestrian street.

jump_cost.description: Cost of a straight jump between two streets the network does not join.

min_chain_m.description: A matched chain shorter than this is dropped as unmatched, in metres.

min_segment_m.description: A matched ground stretch shorter than this is merged into its longest neighbour, in metres.

sigma_z_m.description: Standard deviation of the distance between an observation and its street, in metres.

step_m.description: Spacing of the observations along the route, in metres.

UnmatchedReasonV1.description: Why a segment is not matched (api 1.7).

WarningV1.description: A knowingly degraded or network-dependent output; codes are stable.

message.description: Diagnostic only; clients translate the code.
